summary_en: This Phase 1 study is testing BG-75202, a KAT6A/B inhibitor, alone and with other cancer medicines, in adults with advanced solid tumors, including breast cancer. BG-75202 is taken by mouth, and the other drugs in the combinations are given by mouth or by injection; how long or how often is not stated. The study evaluates safety, tolerability, how the drug moves through and acts in the body, and early signs of antitumor activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa BG-75202, un inhibidor de KAT6A/B, solo y junto con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados, incluido el cáncer de mama. BG-75202 se toma por vía oral, y los otros medicamentos de las combinaciones se administran por vía oral o inyectable; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio evalúa la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el medicamento se distribuye y actúa en el organismo, y las señales tempranas de actividad antitumoral.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older with advanced or metastatic breast cancer or other advanced solid tumors
Breast cancer with 1 to 3 prior lines of treatment in the metastatic setting, with limits on prior chemotherapy
Some cohorts: no prior CDK4/6 inhibitor and no prior systemic treatment for advanced disease, in regions where CDK4/6 inhibitors are not available first-line
Women with metastatic breast cancer must be postmenopausal or receiving ovarian function suppression
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 and ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
not_for: Prior exposure to KAT6A/B or KAT7 inhibitors or degraders
Any other malignancy within 3 years before screening, with listed exceptions
Other protocol-defined exclusion criteria may apply
